title: K-th Value in a Streaming Time Window
prompt:
Implement `WindowKth(window_size)` for a stream of integer `(timestamp, value)` records. `add(timestamp, value)` records an event. `kth(now, k, order='smallest')` returns the k-th smallest or largest value among events in the inclusive interval `[now - window_size, now]`, or `None` if fewer than `k` events remain. Equal values count as separate events.

Assume a positive window size, positive `k`, and valid order values `'smallest'` or `'largest'`. Times across all calls are nondecreasing. Retain data only for the active window; do not retain the full stream history. Explain the time and space costs of your implementation.

Follow-up: what changes if you have a fixed memory budget regardless of the number of events in a window?
